skill.name: multi-client-icp-runner
skill.description: Use saved ideal customer profiles to build separate prospect lists for agency clients through Leadsets. Plan around usage limits, remove duplicates, and separate contacts by email verification status.
skill.summary: Build separate agency client prospect lists from saved profiles and group contacts by email verification status.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The shell, environment access, and reconnaissance alerts match Markdown or documented service behavior, not host access. The workflow uses a required external Leadsets connection and lacks safeguards for destination approval, missing suppression lists, filter changes, and spreadsheet exports. No evidence of prompt injection was found.

remediation.issue: External processing of client search criteria and contact data
remediation.suggestion: Confirm that the client authorizes Leadsets processing. Send only the necessary filters and addresses, and store credentials in the approved connector or secret manager.

remediation.issue: External delivery without destination and access checks
remediation.suggestion: Require approval for the exact destination and account before exporting. Verify ownership and sharing settings, and check whether campaign imports can trigger outreach.

remediation.issue: Missing suppression lists default to no exclusions
remediation.suggestion: Require each client's current suppression list or an explicit waiver. Recheck the final export and report excluded counts without exposing suppression entries.

remediation.issue: An empty probe can broaden search criteria without approval
remediation.suggestion: Keep the approved filters when a probe is empty. Show the proposed change and get approval before running the revised search.
Write untrusted values as literal text in Sheets. Apply spreadsheet-safe escaping for CSV fields and test that exported values cannot be interpreted as formulas.

semantic_findings.title: External Delivery Lacks Destination Verification
semantic_findings.description: The workflow writes contact records through existing Sheets or LinkedCamp connections. It does not require checking the exact destination or its access settings before export.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The skill requires separate lists but does not verify destination ownership or access. An incorrect or broadly shared destination could expose names and work emails.

semantic_findings.title: Missing Suppression Lists Do Not Stop Delivery
semantic_findings.description: Client exclusions are optional and default to none. Campaign exports can include contacts on a client do-not-contact list if the operator omits that list.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The default is explicit, and the workflow filters only against the supplied exclusions. The risk depends on whether a required suppression list was omitted.

semantic_findings.title: Empty Probes Can Expand the Approved Search Scope
semantic_findings.description: The workflow tells the agent to loosen one filter after an empty probe. It requires reporting the change but does not require approval before continuing.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly authorize filter relaxation without an approval step. A relaxed filter can include contacts outside the client's intended criteria.

semantic_findings.title: Spreadsheet Exports Omit Formula Handling
semantic_findings.description: Exported contact fields may contain externally supplied text. The skill does not require treating these values as literal text before writing CSV files or Sheets.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The export rules omit formula safeguards. Whether a value can execute as a formula depends on the connector and how the export is opened.

content.user_title: Build Separate Prospect Lists for Agency Clients
content.value_statement: Refreshing prospect lists for several clients makes it difficult to track usage and keep records separate. This skill applies saved profiles in batches and delivers separate lists grouped by email verification status.
actual_capabilities: Map saved ideal customer profiles to search filters and test each profile with a one-record search.
Check Leadsets allowances and prioritize clients when the batch exceeds the current usage window.
Page through results, apply supplied exclusions, and remove duplicate person IDs within each client.
Enrich contact records and verify addresses that lack a status or come from an imported list.
Deliver separate client lists as CSV files, Google Sheets, or LinkedCamp imports through configured connections.
Report contact totals, excluded records, email status counts, and unfinished clients.
limitations: Requires a Leadsets account and MCP or REST access. Google Sheets and LinkedCamp require separate connections.
Search results and service limits can prevent a client from reaching its target list size.
Verification status reflects the service result and does not guarantee delivery.
Does not write outreach copy, launch sequences, or send email itself.

use_cases.title: Refresh Weekly Client Lists
use_cases.description: Apply saved profiles and current exclusions to create one set of prospect files per client.

use_cases.title: Check a New Client Profile
use_cases.description: Review the search filters and test one matching contact before spending records on the full list.

use_cases.title: Plan a Batch Around Usage Limits
use_cases.description: Check available search and enrichment records, prioritize client runs, and report which clients need a later window.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Client Profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the saved profile for [client] and show the search filters you would use. Do not call Leadsets or export any data.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review the profile before running a search.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Small CSV List
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a CSV prospect list for [client] using its saved profile and current suppression list. Target 25 contacts and keep verified, catch-all, and unknown addresses separate. Ask before changing any filters.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run an approved search for one client.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Prioritized Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Check Leadsets usage and plan a batch for [client A] and [client B]. Prioritize [client A] and estimate how many records each client needs. Identify any work that must wait before starting paid calls.
prompt_templates.scenario: Estimate the work for the current usage window.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Reviewed Multi-Client Export
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the approved profiles, record budgets, and suppression lists for [clients]. Ask me to confirm each external destination and its sharing settings before exporting. Keep each client's contacts separate and report any unfinished work with the reset time.
prompt_templates.scenario: Run a batch with client-specific approvals and delivery destinations.

output_examples.input: Build separate local prospect lists for Client A and Client B using their saved profiles and suppression lists.
output: Client A: 40 verified contacts, 5 catch-all contacts, and 3 unknown contacts. Removed 4 excluded records.
Client B: 27 verified contacts, 2 catch-all contacts, and 1 unknown contact. Removed 2 excluded records.
Each client received separate verified, catch-all, and unknown CSV files.

output_examples.input: Run Client A first and report what must wait when the search allowance runs out.
output: Client A: Completed the export with 50 verified contacts. Kept catch-all and unknown contacts in separate files.
Client B: Not started because the search allowance is exhausted. Resume after the reported reset at 15:00 UTC.

best_practices: Confirm each client's approved filters and current suppression list before searching.
Review the record budget and approve any change to the search criteria.
Verify the exact destination and access settings before exporting contact data.
anti_patterns: Do not mix records from different clients in one file, sheet, or campaign.
Do not treat catch-all, unknown, or historical CRM addresses as verified.
Do not skip suppression checks just because the workflow accepts an empty exclusion list.

faq.question: What is an ICP?
faq.answer: An ideal customer profile describes the companies and roles to search for, including criteria such as industry, seniority, company size, and country.

faq.question: Do I need a Leadsets connection?
faq.answer: Yes. Connect the Leadsets MCP server or use a Leadsets API key for REST access.

faq.question: What happens when the usage allowance runs out?
faq.answer: The workflow reports progress, identifies unfinished clients, and provides the reset time when the service returns one.

faq.question: Which contacts can go to LinkedCamp?
faq.answer: Only contacts marked verified go to LinkedCamp. Catch-all and unknown contacts are returned as separate CSV files.

faq.question: Can I exclude existing customers or past recipients?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide each client's current exclusions as email addresses, domains, or company names.

faq.question: Does the skill send outreach?
faq.answer: No. It exports contacts but does not write messages or launch sequences. Review destination automation before importing contacts into a campaign.
